title: DICIT: Efficacy of diclofenac added to an approved, ongoing PD-1 inhibitor therapy that achieved stable disease as best response in metastatic melanoma patients. A single arm phase II trial
official: DICIT: Efficacy of diclofenac added to an approved, ongoing PD-1 inhibitor therapy that achieved stable disease as best response in metastatic melanoma patients. A single arm phase II trial
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of diclofenac added to an approved, ongoing PD-1 inhibitor therapy that achieved SD as best response in metastatic melanoma patients.

interventions.name: Diclofenac AL 25 Diclofenac-Natrium 25 mg pro magensaftresistente Tablette
Diclo 50 - 1 A Pharma 50 mg magensaftresistente Tabletten

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histologically confirmed, unresectable metastatic melanoma
2. Ongoing treatment with an approved anti-PD-1 therapy with a best response of SD according to (RECIST 1.1.)
3. Patients with BRAF-V600 mutations must have received targeted therapy
4. Availability of adequate tumor tissue accessible for biopsy
5. ECOG 0 or 1
6. Adequate organ function
Exclusion criteria:
1. Active (symptomatic) brain metastases or leptomeningeal metastases
2. Uveal melanoma. Patients with conjunctival melanoma can be enrolled
3. Mucosal melanoma
4. History of heart failure NYHA III-IV
5. History of myocardial infarction or stroke
6. History of gastric ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding
7. Known allergy or hypersensitivity to diclofenac
